q: 我明天___医生见面。
en: I'm meeting the doctor tomorrow.

q: 他感冒了，下周不能___上海出差了。
en: He has a cold and can't go to Shanghai on business next week.

q: 我昨天说错话了，今天应该___她道歉。
en: I said the wrong thing yesterday, so today I should apologise to her.

q: 医生进来以后，先___每位病人握了手。
en: After coming in, the doctor first shook hands with each patient.

q: 下雨天，我喜欢在家___朋友聊天。
en: On rainy days I like to chat with friends at home.

q: 小王还在生我___气吗？
en: Is Xiao Wang still angry with me?

q: 妈妈还在生___气，因为我忘了带伞。
en: Mum is still angry with me because I forgot to take an umbrella.

q: 你能不能___我的忙？我手疼，拿不动箱子。
en: Could you give me a hand? My hand hurts and I can't carry the box.

q: 医生今天特别忙，几个护士主动___他帮了很多忙。
en: The doctor was especially busy today, so several nurses volunteered to help him a lot.

q: 你为什么___我的气？
en: Why are you angry with me?

q: 夏天太热了，我从来没在中午散___步。
en: It's so hot in summer that I've never gone for a walk at noon.

q: 他昨晚一直说___话，我没睡好。
en: He kept talking last night and I didn't sleep well.

q: 明天下班后，我洗___澡就去找你。
en: Tomorrow after work I'll take a shower and then come and find you.

q: 他生病的时候从来没请___假，真厉害。
en: He never took leave even when he was ill, which is really impressive.

q: 夏天放___假，我们就去海边游泳。
en: When the summer holiday starts, we'll go swimming at the seaside.

q: 夜里太吵，我只睡___四个小时觉。
en: It was noisy at night and I only slept four hours.

q: 下雪天，我们在家聊___一个下午的天。
en: On the snowy day we chatted at home for a whole afternoon.

q: 他们___，孩子都上小学了。
en: They've been married for ten years; their child is already in primary school.

q: 他们___，现在都过得很好。
en: They've been divorced for three years and both are doing fine now.

q: 他感冒了，请___三天假。
en: He has a cold and took three days off.

q: 今天天气热，他游泳游___一个小时。
en: It's hot today, and he swam for an hour.

q: 天气太热了，我想先洗___澡。
en: It's too hot, I'd like to take a shower first.

q: 我们只见过两___面，还不太熟。
en: We've only met twice and aren't very close yet.

q: 你能___我一个忙吗？我的手受伤了。
en: Can you do me a favour? My hand is hurt.

q: 他___，不想再结了。
en: He has been married twice and doesn't want to marry again.

q: 天气预报说明天有大雨，公司明天要开___会，讨论大家怎么来上班。
en: The forecast says heavy rain tomorrow, so the company will hold a meeting to discuss how everyone gets to work.

q: 春天来了，我们出去___吧。
en: Spring is here, let's go out for a little walk.

q: 下雨天没事做，来我家___吧。
en: Nothing to do on a rainy day, so come over to my place for a chat.

q: 昨天雪很大，我们在家聊___聊天，喝了热茶。
en: It snowed heavily yesterday; we chatted at home and drank hot tea.

q: 冬天外面太冷，你就在家___，不用出去了。
en: It's too cold outside; just sing a little at home and don't go out.

q: 他说话___很慢。
en: He speaks very slowly.

q: 冬天我睡觉___很早，晚上九点就睡了。
en: In winter I go to bed very early, at nine in the evening.

q: 她跳舞跳___非常好，不像生过病的人。
en: She dances extremely well, not like someone who has been ill.

q: 路上有雪，所以她今天___不太快。
en: There's snow on the road, so she isn't running very fast today.

q: 他的歌___特别好，连医生都夸他。
en: He sings especially well; even the doctor praised him.

q: 你生___气？我又没说错话。
en: What are you angry about? I didn't say anything wrong.

q: 昨晚太热了，我一直睡不___觉。
en: It was so hot last night that I couldn't fall asleep.

q: 昨天雨很大，我上___课就回家了。
en: It rained hard yesterday, and I went home as soon as class was over.

q: 我感冒了，已经三天没睡___觉了。
en: I have a cold and haven't slept properly for three days.

q: 外面下大雨，你___饭再走吧。
en: It's pouring outside; finish your meal before you leave.
